test_title: PYST 23: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 15 Mar 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

He has come __**out on**__ a brilliant idea of taking us to Jodhpur for the weekend.
solution:
The correct answer is** "up with"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the meaning of the word "**out on" **and other words given in the options.

 
 
• **Out on **means intent on having.

 
 
• **Example:- **Everyone was getting bored and he came out on of having a tea break.
 
 
 
• **Up With **means an exclamation expressing support for a stated person or thing.
 
 
• **Example:- **His brother comes up with strong support for her.
 
 
 
• **Over to **means extending directly upwards from.
 
 
• **Example:- **I saw flames over Berlin
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence, according to the meaning of the sentence the correct answer is the option no 2.
